item.title: How to unlock hurricanes in GTA 6
item.description: To unlock hurricanes in Grand Theft Auto 6 , you must find and befriend Freddie, a prepper (and rapper) living in a hidden bunker. Complete Freddie's side mission, and the weather is sure to turn foul, though your chances of witnessing a hurricane first-hand depend on the mission's final choice.

item.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong Team Officially Confirms Sea of Sorrow DLC Release Date
item.description: It’s time for more bug-themed suffering. Hollow Knight: Silksong — Sea of Sorrow , the first DLC for last year’s megahit Metroidvania, will be released in December, developer Team Cherry announced Friday during its Cherry Time! games showcase. Given how long it took for Silksong — a game that was originally supposed to be an add-on — to come out, many fans are likely breathing a sigh of relief. The high-seas adventure-themed DLC was first teased last December .

item.title: Why Critical Role's Shorter Episodes Are Officially Here to Stay
item.description: Critical Role is by far the most popular Dungeons & Dragons actual-play show, with more than a decade of role-playing antics including one-shots, live shows, and hundreds of hours of tabletop campaigns. Its adventures are so beloved that the company has even adapted them into the Prime video animated series The Legend of Vox Machina and The Mighty Nein .

item.title: Nintendo Officially Launches Black Friday Deals on Switch 2 and Games
item.description: Nintendo has officially launched its Black Friday 2026 deals , giving frugal holiday shoppers an opportunity to get a pair of Nintendo Switch 2 system bundles at a discount. Nintendo is also putting select digital and physical games for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 on sale, with discounts on games such as Super Mario Party Jamboree and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond .

item.title: PlayStation Announces New Black Friday Deals On Hardware
item.description: Black Friday 2026 is here, and PlayStation is offering big discounts on games and gaming hardware for the big holiday shopping event. There are plenty of digital game deals at Sony's PlayStation Store as well as physical games at retailers like Amazon . PlayStation's official Black Friday hardware deals also include PlayStation 5 hardware, including the DualSense controller, PlayStation VR2, and Pulse audio accessories.

item.title: HBO Officially Teases New Thriller Series from Dark Creators
item.description: The 2017 German sci-fi mystery thriller series Dark aired for three seasons on Netflix, gaining critical acclaim and a global cult following. Its complex plot explored the paradoxical nature of time travel through strange mysteries in the fictional town of Winden, Germany.

item.title: 35 Years Later, Hollywood’s Deadliest Feud Is Still Its Most Reliable Fantasy Formula
item.description: At the time, the interaction, while hilarious, also made perfect sense. Popular culture was deep in the thrall of Stephenie Meyer’s Twilight , which famously pits a vampire and a werewolf against each other for the affections of a human girl. But a decade later, the idea that vampires and werewolves would be natural enemies seems a bit odd.

item.title: 10 Best Black Friday Board Game Deals
item.description: One of the great joys of the holidays is finally getting everyone around the same table. Another is watching your cousin realize that the road they’ve been building for the last six turns is about to go nowhere. You don’t get many chances to do that as an adult. Make the most of it.

item.title: The Best Black Friday Gaming Deals of 2026
item.description: It's shopping time again — Black Friday is here. And while some retailers started offering discounts a week or more ago, it's always true that the best deals don't materialize until the day itself. That day has come.
